gaps.sentence: He was ___ (SUSPECT) of fraud last year.
gaps.explanation: 'Was suspected of' — passive; 'suspicious' describes a person who suspects.
Negative prefix for 'legal' is 'il-' before l: illegal.

gaps.sentence: He made a full ___ (RECOVER) after six months.
The city is ___ (FAME) for its architecture.
gaps.explanation: 'Famous for' — 'infamous' means notorious (famous for bad things).

gaps.sentence: The report was highly ___ (CRITICISE) of the ministry.
gaps.explanation: 'Be critical of' — adjective; 'criticism' is the noun.

gaps.sentence: She gave a moving ___ (PERFORM) of the sonata.
gaps.explanation: 'A performance of the sonata' — the act of performing.
